name: unauthorized-get
description: The same AI/ML API 401 envelope as `unauthorized`, on a GET (captured 2026-10-15 against /v1/key with a deliberately invalid key). A separate chain only because replay matches on METHOD and url: the read endpoints (#models, #key) are GETs and the billable ones POSTs, and the gateway's refusal body is identical for both. `instance` is the captured path.

body.title: Unauthorized
body.message: This request requires a valid API key. You can create a new API key on the Billing page: https://aimlapi.com/app/keys

error.name: UnauthorizedException
error.message: This request requires a valid API key. You can create a new API key on the Billing page: https://aimlapi.com/app/keys
